latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the superpowers-requesting-code-review skill.

- Provides clear guidelines for when and how to request code reviews.
- Defines a repeatable process for dispatching a code-reviewer subagent, including gathering git SHAs and filling a review template.
- Outlines mandatory and optional review scenarios to ensure thorough and timely review.
- Details feedback handling protocol: fixing critical/important issues and challenging mistaken reviews.
- Includes example workflow integration and red flags to avoid.
